content: The document titled Consolidated HIV Strategic Information Guidelines: Driving Impact Through Programme Monitoring and Management is a publication by the World Health Organization (WHO) in 2020. It includes a Web Annex (Annex A) that maps the 2020 indicators to the 2015 guideline indicators. The electronic version of this document is identified by the ISBN 978-92-4-000436-8.
